issue.title: Keep-moving marks 200-link surface timing gate flakes under full plugin suite load
issue.description: scripts/test-ledger-tools-keep-moving-marks-surface.cjs measures the 200-link Live Preview build with one performance.now interval and asserts <250ms. Full npm test measured 312.7ms, while the same source passed both the 4-worker full suite and focused 36-test control. Functional assertions retain 200 decorations and exactly one parent resolution. The full suite had concurrent Rust compilation and other agent load. Small scope: stabilize this single-sample wall-clock test without weakening functional checks or blindly raising the budget. Same-type/all-type searches and the last-week sweep found only distinct off-clock/frees-mark tests; active epics do not own this node. See related bob-cli-io for the same measurement pattern on another node.

task_type_fields.evidence: One failure in three runs of the same timing node: full-suite default concurrency failed 312.7ms >250; four-worker full suite and focused suite passed. @/tmp/revert-leaf-npm.log @/tmp/revert-leaf-npm-limited.log @/tmp/revert-leaf-perf-control.log

issue.creation_reason: Approved leaf-rule revert verification hit the keep-moving surface wall-clock limit only under full-suite concurrency; focused and reduced-concurrency controls pass.
